title: Simulated Diagram Snapshots
description: Allows you to save a render of your simulated contraption using the diagram.
body:
Simulated Diagram Snapshots
Lets you take those perfect looking renders of an airship from the contraption diagram.

![Cloudskipper Render](https://github.com/cakeGit/Simulated-Diagram-Snapshots/blob/main/img/Cloud%20Skipper.png?raw=true)

![Ingame Menu](https://github.com/cakeGit/Simulated-Diagram-Snapshots/blob/main/img/Ingame%20Menu.png?raw=true)

![Scale preservation](https://github.com/cakeGit/Simulated-Diagram-Snapshots/blob/main/img/Scale%20Preservation.png?raw=true)

Works fully client side, and stores renders in `screenshots/diagrams/`.

**Note: this mod has some limitations when trying to render very large airships at high resolutions, but this shouldnt affect reasonable use.**
